title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Knocks Daima Out of the Anime’s Timeline Again
content:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is now in the midst of its new remake anime run this Fall, and unfortunately the newest episode has once again knocked the events of Dragon Ball Daima out of the anime’s timeline to make it all that much more confusing. As Akira Toriyama’s final project, Dragon Ball Daima set Goku on a new adventure through the Demon Realm and officially introduced previously non-canonical events like Super Saiyan 4 Goku and Super Saiyan Vegeta 3 to Toriyama’s canon. But this raised a lot of questions about Dragon Ball Super’ s own future.

Dragon Ball Super returned to screens with a brand new remake series taking on the original TV anime series from the very beginning, and with it unfortunately has once again made the anime’s timeline all the more confusing as it continues to ignore the events of Dragon Ball Daima . Because while that series had retconned new forms and ideas into the timeline from Toriyama himself, Dragon Ball Super: Beerus doesn’t really change its events with as big of changes as fans might have wanted to see from the anime .

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Ignores Dragon Ball Daima

When Dragon Ball Super: Beerus was first announced to be an enhanced edition of the original TV anime series with new cuts, visual effects and retooled footage, there was a hope that there would be changes to address new additions from Dragon Ball Daima or previously ignored changes from the Dragon Ball Super manga release. But that’s not the case at all. For example, Dragon Ball Daima had revealed that since the fight with Majin Buu, the Supreme Kai and Kibito had found a way to defuse from the Potara Earrings that led the Kai to going on a new adventure with Goku.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ first couple of episodes debunk this immediately with Kibitokai’s return to the anime, but there was a hope that Goku’s fight with Beerus would somehow slip in a reference to Super Saiyan 4. With the latest episode showing off the updated version of their confrontation, Super Saiyan 3 is the strongest form that Goku has at his disposal despite the fact that the end of Daima teases that Goku would be able to tap into this transformation again. Which just further throws everything into chaos.

What Does This Mean for Dragon Ball Daima ?

Despite not lining up with Dragon Ball Super’ s anime in the slightest, Dragon Ball Daima is as official of a part of the canon as any project could get. With new story, designs, and ideas coming from the late Akira Toriyama himself, there’s no better stamp on the anime than fans could ask for. That’s even less of the case with Dragon Ball Super as the anime team has its own input into its story . With this remake not making any crucial adjustments to how the original TV anime series played out, it’s only going to further brush Dragon Ball Daima under the rug.

This does sting a little bit as now Dragon Ball is moving forward without Akira Toriyama around , and that means the future of the series will likely further ignore the last of his contributions to his franchise. Dragon Ball Daima took place after Majin Buu and before Battle of Gods, and while it raised timeline questions, it more sparked a lot of potential ideas about what it could have meant for Goku and Vegeta’s future.

But that’s no longer going to be the case as Dragon Ball Super’ s anime continues with brand new arcs in the years to come. What do you think of Dragon Ball Daima no longer being a part of the anime’s timeline again? Would you want to see it addressed further? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Rin Shimokawa's 'Godmother' Manga from Young Magazine US Starts Seralization on November 18
content:
The original one-shot centered on Kinryu, a college girl who is suddenly forced to drop out of college and move overseas to Japan. She goes to take care of a 114 year old grandmother whom she did not even know existed. Disgruntled and angry, she nevertheless makes it to Yokohama, and finds her grandmother living behind a mahjong parlor. There, Kinryu is forced to know about a supernatural secret that runs in the female side of her family.

Nishio launched the original one-shot as part of Kodansha 's special Young Magazine US English issue in August 2025.

The top five winners are guaranteed serialization on Kodansha 's K MANGA app. The winners will also be serialized in Japan in Monthly Young Magazine and/or YanMaga Web , serializing at the same time on K MANGA .

Other winning titles include Still You , To Dusk and Twilight , Boys Run the Riot -In Transition- , Protocol Ryugu , and The Last Terran . To Dusk and Twilight , Protocol Ryugu , and The Last Terran are all currently in serialization . The Last Terran was the most recent to start, launching in Monthly Young Magazine on August 20.

One of the winning manga, Daisuke Itabashi 's The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers , began serialization in Japan in the January 2026 issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Young Magazine in December 2025. Ray Kindō 's The Knight of Blasphemy ( Tokushin no Chevalier ) manga launched in the August issue on July 16. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers , and will begin releasing it in print in March 2027.

title: Legendary Isekai Releases New English Dub for Reboot After 32 Years
content:
It’s been 32 years since this legendary Isekai anime series first made its debut, and now Magic Knight Rayearth has kicked off a new era with the start of its English dub release for the new reboot anime. CLAMP’s Magic Knight Rayearth is one of the most legendary anime franchises of all time. With the anime first making its debut on screens 32 years ago , it’s now returned all these decades later with a brand new reboot series adapting it from the very beginning. And that means a new English dub too.

Magic Knight Rayearth has officially returned to screens with the start of a new reboot anime 32 years after the premiere of the first TV anime series , and it was revealed to be a part of the English dub schedule for Crunchyroll as part of their Fall 2026 slate as well. The wait for this new English dub release has now come to an end, however, as the first episode of the dub is now streaming with Crunchyroll as they have revealed the full voice cast and release schedule for the reboot moving forward.

Magic Knight Rayearth Reboot English Dub Premieres With Crunchyroll

The premiere episode of Magic Knight Rayearth’ s English dub release is now streaming with Crunchyroll as of Wednesday, October 21st and new episodes of the dub will then be releasing on a weekly basis from here on out . With only three episodes of the Japanese audio release out as of the time of this dub premiere, it’s not going to be too much of a wait before fans all get to catch up with all of the new releases. As for the new voice cast behind this next era of the anime franchise, it has been revealed in full as well.

The English dub voice cast for the Magic Knight Rayearth stars the likes of Rebecca Chiara Marano as Hikaru, Bryn Apprill as Umi, Kelly Greenshield as Fuu, Caitlin Glass as Emeraude, Bradley Gareth as Zagato, Jacob Hopkins as Clef, Erin Nicole Lundquist as Alcyone, Christopher Wehkamp as Lafarga, Cassie Ewulu as Caldina, Sarah Roach as Ascot, and Abigail Blythe, Monica Flatley, Lisette Monique Diaz, Kayla Temshiv, Kayla Parker, Kim Rivera, Samantha Snow, Marcus D. Stimac, Kiane Chula King in additional roles.

What to Know for Magic Knight Rayearth Reboot

Magic Knight Rayearth ‘s new anime reboot is directed by Yui Miura for E&H Production ( Ninja Kamui, Bullet/Bullet ) with Kadokawa and TMS Entertainment overseeing its production. Shigeru Murakoshi is handling the scripts with Satomi Watabe handling the character designs, and Yuki Kajiura, Takumi Ozawa and Shiho Terada composing the music. Based off of CLAMP’s original manga series, this is a full re-adaptation of the manga for a new era. And likely going to be a complete take on the story.

Making its original anime debut over three decades ago at this point, it’s an Isekai that often doesn’t get the credit it truly deserves. Magic Knight Rayearth has three young girls being whisked away to a new fantasy world, and sees them tasked with saving a princess using giant mecha armors and magic to fight. The reboot has been a success with fans thus far, but now fans of the dub can see why too.

Are you going to check out the English dub for Magic Knight Rayearth ? How are you liking the new reboot so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Simpsons Showrunner Teases Apu’s Future Following Recast
content:
The Simpsons has officially reintroduced Apu back into the animated series after a nearly decade long absence, and the showrunner behind it all teases we’ll see much more of him in future episodes. Before being at the center of a major controversy behind his portrayal , Apu was one of the most important side characters in The Simpsons overall. He had some of the key focus episodes outside of the Simpson family themselves, so it was pretty noticeable when he suddenly disappeared for a nine year stint.

That’s why The Simpsons Season 38 got a lot of attention with the most recent episode as it not only fully brought Apu back with his first speaking role since 2017 , but also introduced new voice actor Sunil Maholtra taking over the role moving forward. Addressing the recast with Variety , The Simpsons showrunner Matt Selman confirmed that fans will be seeing much more of Apu moving forward, “We’re excited by what Sunil has already brought to the role, and look forward to seeing more of Apu in the future.”

The Simpsons Teases More of Apu After Recasting Role

As detailed by Variety, Matt Selman confirmed that Apu and his wife Manjula (who has also been recast with Janina Gavankar taking over the role) will be appearing on the show more often now that the Nahasapeemapetilon family and Kwik-E-Mart location have been reintegrated back into the animated series in full. “We love this character, and wanted to bring him back in a smart, ‘Simpsons’-y way that allowed him to evolve,” the showrunner stated. “We’re excited by what Sunil has already brought to the role, and look forward to seeing more of Apu in the future.”

The Simpsons fully brought Apu back into the series with “Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening.” First it was revealed that Apu had been openly killed and ignored by the rest of the town ( along with some other missing faces ), only to then be a nightmare that Apu had been having. It was the series directly addressing the fact that following Hank Azaria retiring from the role following a controversy over the character’s portrayal of his Hindu origins, The Simpsons had retired Apu from the series overall.

What Does This Mean for Apu’s Future in The Simpsons ?

Speaking about the casting process, new Apu voice actor Sunil Maholtra explained that he worked closely with Selman and the rest of the team on the character’s portrayal for the episode and beyond, “It was the beginning of a deeply collaborative experience that I hope is equally satisfying for longtime fans of ‘The Simpsons’ and for other South Asian kids who, like me, stopped watching at some point along the way.” The episode itself further emphasized Apu’s return with Homer once again acknowledging him as one of his best friends.

This was a move that the team at The Simpsons did not take lightly. When Azaria retired from the role in 2020, he explained that the team at the series just “froze” at the thought of how to move forward with the character following raised concerns about the character’s portrayal of race . This led to many unspeaking background appearances since 2017, so Apu’s return is likely also going to come with a return to prominence from the character who was at the center of some of the series’ biggest events of the past.

What are you hoping to see from Apu’s return in The Simpsons? How are you feeling about his new voice actor so far? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – Variety

title: Demon Slayer Teases Jump Festa 2027 With New Update
content:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba is one of the many franchises taking the stage during Shueisha’s Jump Festa 2027 event coming later this year, and now it’s teasing more of what fans can expect with a new update. Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba is now in the works on the second of the major films in the Infinity Castle trilogy, but has yet to reveal any updates about the project. With the first film now available on streaming , it means there’s a clear runway for the second film at last.

Shueisha’s annual Jump Festa event is where they show off updates on all of the new anime and manga projects they have in the works, and that’s what makes it especially exciting for Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba as it’s going to be the perfect opportunity for an update on the next film . Revealed as one of the franchises with something to showcase during the event, a new update has now revealed that the panel will also feature members of the voice cast live-dubbing moments as chosen by the fans.

Demon Slayer Teases Jump Festa 2027 Panel & Updates

Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba will be hosting its panel during Jump Festa 2027 on Sunday, December 20th in Japan and it’s going to feature members of the voice cast such as Natsuki Hanae (Tanjiro), Akari Kito (Nezuko), Hiro Shimono (Zenitsu), and Yoshitsugu Matsuoka (Inosuke) in attendance. They will be dubbing scenes as voted on by fans, but the hope is that the panel will also offer a much needed update on the next Infinity Castle film. With no news revealed thus far, a first look would go a long way.

Shueisha’s annual Jump Festa event is often the biggest convention of the year for Shonen Jump fans as it comes with major news about all of the new developments for each of the magazine’s notable franchises. With the second film not revealing a release window, production cast, or other details as of this time, any small update would be seen as a big step forward. Especially as fans currently don’t really know how long they’re going to have to wait to see the next film in action.

When Does Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 2 Come Out?

The success of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle I has been a double-edged sword for fans, however . It was such a hit across theaters in Japan that it remained screening for nine long months after its initial release, and didn’t get an official digital store or streaming launch until a full year after that first launch. This has also meant that promotions were focused on the first film through that year, and there’s really been no real need to start promoting what’s next for the second film.

That’s all set to change in the immediate future, however, as Studio Ufotable will soon be releasing their newest feature film effort Witch on the Holy Night this Fall in Japan. With this film taking up all of their time and attention for the past year as well, its release will soon free it up for Demon Slayer ‘s rollout for the second film. Jump Festa 2027 could be the first major step forward for the sequel, but what are you hoping to see from the event? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Magic Knight Rayearth, Sasaki and Peeps 2nd Season Anime Reveal English Dub Debuts, Casts
content:
The English dub of Magic Knight Rayearth stars:

• Rebecca Chiara Marano as Hikaru

• Bryn Apprill as Umi

• Kelly Greenshield as Fuu

• Caitlin Glass as Emeraude

• Bradley Gareth as Zagato

• Jacob Hopkins as Clef

• Erin Nicole Lundquist as Alcyone

• Christopher Wehkamp as Lafarga

• Cassie Ewulu as Caldina

• Sarah Roach as Ascot

The dub staff includes:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Samantha Herek

• Adaptation Supervisor: Ben Phillips

• Adaptation: Jessica Sluys

• Adaptation Prep: Marilyn M. Reyes

• Voice Director: Jonathan Rigg

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Jeremy Woods

• Assistant Engineers: Lyndon Douglas, Stevie Rae Kreiger

• Mixer: William Dewell

The anime debuted on October 7 in the "IMAnimation W" programming block on TV Asahi and affiliated channels at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EDT).

Magic Knight Rayearth centers on three high school girls named Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu. On a class field trip to Tokyo Tower, they are magically transported into the fantasy world of Cefiro. They are immediately greeted by the mage Clef, who tells them that the world is dying after the priest Zagato kidnapped Princess Emeraude, whose prayers maintain the state of the world. Without her singing, Cefiro is on the brink of collapse. Imbued with magical powers as the Magic Knights, Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu must learn how to work together to survive and save Cefiro.

The creative circle CLAMP serialized the Magic Knight Rayearth manga in Kodansha 's Nakayoshi magazine from 1993 to 1996 with six volumes. The manga inspired two television anime seasons, the first running from October 1994 to March 1995, and the second season, titled Magic Knight Rayearth 2 , running from April to November 1995. The manga also inspired a three-episode 1997 original video anime project simply titled Rayearth , featuring an alternate retelling of the story.

• Tyson Rinehart as Sasaki

• Erin Nicole Lundquist as Peeps

• Taylor Murphy as Neighbor

• Hollis Beck as Abaddon

• Robin Clayton as Shizuka

• Ray Hurd as Müller

• Lisette Monique Diaz as Elsa

• Reagan Murdock as Akutsu

• Julie Cleburn as Hoshizaki

• Charles Nguyen as Adonis

• Kirsty Johnson as Neighbor's Mother

• Cory Phillips as Man

• Jennifer AuBuchon as Magical Pink

• Randy Pearlman as King

title: Attack on Titan’s Final Movie Confirms U.S. Blu-ray Release Date With First Look
content:
Attack on Titan’ s grand finale has now confirmed it’s finally coming to 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray as Crunchyroll has set a release date for its launch in the United States with the first look at what to expect. Attack on Titan might have ended its manga and anime run some time ago, but the franchise is going stronger than ever this year. With the original franchise celebrating some milestone anniversaries and even getting an official holiday in Japan , the franchise has been in the midst of a big comeback.

As part of this comeback for the wider franchise, Crunchyroll is also getting in on the fun with its own new release planned too. Attack on Titan: The Last Attack is a feature film release that combines the events of the original two finale specials and offers updated visuals and even has a new scene not seen in the TV versions. Now this film has confirmed it’s coming to shelves with a new 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray™ SteelBook® combo pack on January 26th next year. Check out the first look images for it below.

Attack on Titan: The Last Attack Movie Confirms U.S. Release Date

Attack on Titan: The Last Attack 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray™ SteelBook® combo pack will be releasing on January 26, 2027, and will be available for purchase with the Crunchyroll Store and select retailers. This is an updated version of the two finale specials that originally aired on TV. It got an official release across theaters in Japan and even the United States and Canada last year , but it was a very limited occasion. It was definitely worth going out to see it for those who wanted to see more of the anime, however.

Attack on Titan: The Last Attack saw director Yuichiro Hayashi oversee a re-edit of the original TV finale specials and added new cuts, and updated sequences for this more complete version of the finale. It even went further with an additional scene not seen with the original TV anime episodes, and acted as a sort of special epilogue that gave fans one last look at Eren and the others as they existed in a world outside of the bounds of their suffering . But there’s still even more on the way.

What’s Next for Attack on Titan ?

Following the celebration of Attack on Titan Day earlier this Fall, it was officially announced that Studio MAPPA would be returning to the franchise for one more anime release. It’s not going to be as expansive as some fans might hope, however, as they will be animating the opening sequence for the upcoming release of the Attack on Titan 3 video game . The overall length and content of this opening has yet to be confirmed, but it’s an exciting return for the studio either way.

Attack on Titan: The Last Attack is getting an upgraded release for theaters in Japan as part of this holiday and anniversary celebration , but that doesn’t seem to be planned for international fans at this time. Until then, this Blu-ray release is going to be the ultimate way to check it all out when it hit shelves. Are you excited to jump back into the world of Attack on Titan ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother Mystery Game's Trailer Reveals March 18 Release
content:
Koei Tecmo began streaming on Wednesday a gameplay trailer for The Apothecary Diaries : The False Imperial Brother , a new game based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, and it reveals that the game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam on March 18. The video previews the mysteries, concoctions, and investigations:

The game will get a Digital Deluxe Edition that includes costume packs.

The company describes the story:

Two chains of strange phenomenon and conspiracies are causing chaos throughout the rear palace, red-light district, and streets of the capital. Apothecary Maomao must use every ounce of her intelligence and knowledge to solve the mysteries and unveil the truth behind the False Imperial Brother before it destroys the imperial court.

In the game, players control Maomao as she explores, compounds, and investigates to solve mysteries.

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print.

The novels are inspiring a television anime . The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub . The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll streamed the second season, and it also streamed an English dub .

The third season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

The anime also has an upcoming anime film titled Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ( The Apothecary Diaries : The Deceased Empress' Treasure) that will open in theaters on December 11 and feature a brand-new story by Hyuganatsu .

Amazon Prime Video is producing a live-action series adaptation that will stream exclusively worldwide on the service in 2028.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Just Crossed a Disappointing Milestone
content:
Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has just crossed a disappointing milestone with its hiatus as the manga is currently showing no signs of return after a full year. Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has been an absolute powerhouse ever since the manga first made its debut in the pages of Shogakukan’s Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine in 2020, and that’s been even more the case with the success of its official TV anime adaptation . Unfortunately, it’s been a while since fans have seen new chapters of the manga hit the magazine.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End had announced it would be going on an indefinite hiatus following the release of Chapter 147 on October 14th in Japan last year , and unfortunately it’s been a full year without any new updates on the next chapter of the series. This is an unfortunate milestone for the manga release, but also makes fans worry even more for series creators Kanehito Yamada and Tsukasa Abe as the two of them went on hiatus for health concerns.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Hiatus Has Now Lasted Over a Year

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End originally confirmed it would be going on an indefinite hiatus last year due to health concerns for its creators, but has yet to reveal any potential update for its return. The manga has had a number of hiatuses and extended breaks through its tenure thus far, and even had a hiatus last for a few months last year before it went on hiatus again in October . It’s been a bumpy road for the fans keeping up with the manga, and it’s gotten even more eyes in the last few years thanks to the anime bringing in more fans.

Even with Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End being on this extended hiatus, however, the manga is still topping sales charts in Japan . Though this has been far from the only hiatus for the series, and is currently the longest one of its serialization yet, the story has been so appealing to fans that they are still supporting it in any way they can. That’s even more true as with new episodes of the anime now in the works for a release next year, even more potential fans are going to seek out the manga to see what’s next.

When Does Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 Come Out?

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is currently scheduled to make its debut sometime next October as part of the Fall 2027 anime schedule. The new season will have a returning production staff and cast with Tomoya Kitagawa returning as director for Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 for Madhouse with Tomomi Suzuki handling the composition , Maru Takase and Keisuke Kojima providing the character designs, and Evan Call composing the music. It’s also going to be taking on the biggest arc of the series to date with this coming season.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 will be adapting The Golden Land Arc which fans got small teases of during the second season. The new season will be introducing Macht, who is currently hailed as the strongest of the Seven Sages of Destruction . Macht has yet to be officially cast as of this time, but you can catch up with everything that’s happened in the anime thus far now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

Can you believe Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has been on hiatus for a year? Are you taking this time to catch up? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Singer AKINO Graduates from bless4; Band Changes Name to 'bless∞(Forever)'
content:
AKINO has been with Bless4 for 24 years.

AKINO debuted with her brothers Akashi and AIKI and her sister Kanasa in the band Bless4 , with the single "Good Morning! Mr.Sunshine." AKINO made her solo debut with the " Genesis of Aquarion " and "Go Tight" singles for the Genesis of Aquarion anime, both composed by Yōko Kanno . She has since then performed several songs for anime, including Oban Star-Racers , and Kantai Collection - Kan Colle - , Active Raid , and Amagi Brilliant Park , as well as games such as Final Fantasy XIV .

The band, which included four siblings from the Japanese American Kawamitsu family, debuted in Japan in 2003. They have contributed songs to the Disney-produced anime Stitch! , Izetta: The Last Witch , and The Ancient Magus' Bride . AIKI left the band in 2022 to focus on family and his solo career. Originally from Phoenix, AZ, the band members live in Kawasaki, and have performed in Korea and released songs in Europe.
